Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR SCISSORS, CROWN, 
DENTAL. STRAIGHT AND CURVED ON FLAT 



1. Scope — Dimensions and requiremeftts of dental crown scissors, straight and curved on flat. 

2. Shape and Dimensions 




I SECTION XX 



ON ONE BLADE 




M 2 SCREW 

CURVED ON 
FLAT 




no STRAIGHT 



FINGER LOOP No. 1 



All dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG. I SCISSORS, CROWN. DENTAL. STRAIGHT AND CURVED ON FLAT 



2.1 The screw used shall be slotted raised cheese head pattern as shown in Fig. 2, The profile of the screw 
thread shall conform to IS:42I8 (Part I)- 1968*. The thread shall be of such length as to allow sufficient 
shaniy for proper bearing surface and to adequately secure component parts of the scissors with proper 
tensijon for cutting. The screw shall retain proper position after setting without binding and loosening 
duririg the use. The screw end may be left projecting up to 0"5 mm. 



*ISO metric screw threads: Part I Basic and design profiles.

FIG. 2 DETAIL OF SCREW ASSEMBLY 

2.2 Finger Loop-The finger loop shall be properly shaped and size shall conform to Size No. I of 12 of 
Section 5 of IS :3M2-I96.6*. 

3. Material -Instrument shall be made of carbon steel conforming to Designation T80 of Schedule VI of 
IS: I570-I96lt. 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The scissors shall be symmetrical and well balanced. 

4.2 The blades shall open and close without stiffness and shall have a slight crossover action to give 
continuous pinch and shall have no play at the joint. 

4.3 The scissors shall be free from cracks, seams, burrs, flaws and like defects. The surfaces of the scissors 
shall be finished smooth, passivated and polished bright. The edges shall be even and rounded except for 
the cutting edges which shall be sharp. The cutting edges shall not have any feathers. 

4.4 The scissors shall be plated chromium over nickel and the plating shall conform to Service Grade 
NQ. 2 of IS : 1 068- 1 968 J. 

5. Hardness-The scissors shall be evenly hardened and tempered to 693 to 700 HV, 

6. Performance Test-The scissors shall be tested by cutting 0'7I0 mm diameter soft stainless steel wire. 
The wire shall be cut easily and cleanly. The test shall be carried out five times. On completion of the 
test, the scissots shall show no sign of damage. 

7. Marking-Each scissors shall be legibly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's name, initials or 

tiade-matk and the country of manufacture. 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking- Details available from Indian Standards Institution, New Delhi I. 

8. Packing- As given in IS:428I-I967§.
